english: Excuse me, but…\pOur leader, the SALON MAIDEN, is on\nher way here in hopes of battling you.\pShe should be arriving very shortly.
dutch: Pardon, maar…\pOnze leider, de SALON MAIDEN, komt\nnaar je toe om tegen je te vechten.\pZe is er zo.

english: You will be facing the SALON MAIDEN.\nAre you prepared?
dutch: Je tegenstander is de SALON MAIDEN.\nBen je klaar?

english:
Greetings…
My name is ANABEL.\pI am the SALON MAIDEN, and I am in
charge of running the BATTLE TOWER…\pI have heard several rumors
about you…\pIn all honesty, what I have heard does
not seem attractive in any way…\pThe reason I've come to see you…
Well, there is but one reason…
dutch:
Hallo…
Ik ben ANABEL.\pIk ben de SALON MAIDEN en ik leid
de BATTLE TOWER…\pIk heb een paar geruchten
over je gehoord…\pEerlijk gezegd klonken ze niet
zo mooi…\pIk kom omdat…
Er is maar één reden…

english: Let me see your talent in\nits entirety…
dutch: Laat me al je talent zien…

english: ANABEL: Fufufu, nicely done…\pYour FRONTIER PASS, please…\nYour talent shall be recognized.
dutch: ANABEL: Fufufu, goed gedaan…\pJe FRONTIER PASS, alsjeblieft…\nJe talent wordt erkend.

english: The Ability Symbol was embossed on\nthe FRONTIER PASS!
dutch: Het Ability-symbool is nu op\nde FRONTIER PASS gezet!

english:
… … … … … …\pYou have confidence in your POKéMON
battling talent, don't you?\pI urge you to keep battling and
keep on winning.\pI will be waiting for you.
Until the next time we meet…
dutch: … … … … … …\pJe vertrouwt op je POKéMON,\nhè?\pBlijf vechten en blijf winnen.\pIk wacht op je.\nTot de volgende keer…

english:
ANABEL: You really did come back to
see me…\p… … … … … …\pYou've won straight matches to see me…
I won't have to hold back against you…\pIt's been too long now…\pToo long since I've been able to battle
without thinking about anything…
dutch: ANABEL: Je bent echt teruggekomen…\p… … … … … …\pJe hebt veel gewonnen om mij te\nzien… Ik hoef niet in te houden…\pHet is te lang geleden…\pTe lang geleden dat ik kon vechten\nzonder ergens aan te denken…

english: Let's begin, shall we?
dutch: Zullen we beginnen?

english: ANABEL: Fufu, congratulations…\nYour FRONTIER PASS, please…
dutch: ANABEL: Fufu, gefeliciteerd…\nJe FRONTIER PASS, alsjeblieft…

english: The Ability Symbol took on\na golden shine!
dutch: Het Ability-symbool is nu\ngoud geworden!

english: That was fun…\pI have never had a POKéMON battle\nso enjoyable before…\pI wish I could battle with you again…
dutch: Dat was leuk…\pIk heb nog nooit zo\ngenoten van een gevecht…\pIk wou dat ik weer tegen je\nkon vechten…
